title: Even/odd splitting for summable complex series

problemStatement.formal: theorem tsum_even_add_odd {f : ℕ → ℂ} (h : Summable f) : ∑' k : ℕ, f (2 * k) + ∑' k : ℕ, f (2 * k + 1) = ∑' n : ℕ, f n
problemStatement.plain: For any summable complex sequence, the sum over even-indexed terms plus the sum over odd-indexed terms equals the original infinite series. This axiom-elimination target removes the even/odd series-splitting axiom from the parent Euler identity proof.
whyMatters: Eliminates one of the parent Euler identity proof's explicit axioms.
Provides a reusable infinite-sum reindexing lemma for future Taylor-series and Fourier-series formalizations.
Exercises the `Equiv.tsum_eq` pattern for splitting countable topological sums by an even/odd bijection.
